exposure: organizational level of Maternity Unit (Level I vs. Level II)
outcome: maternal birth satisfaction (measured by BSS-R total score and sub-scales: Quality of care, Stress Experienced, Women's Attributes)
cohort: The study included 1642 women who gave birth in 11 Italian Maternity Units classified as Level I or Level II.
finding: Overall maternal birth satisfaction was similar between Level I and Level II Maternity Units, but women giving birth in Level I units reported a greater Quality of care sub-scale score.
